notes.title: 🛠️ Minor Update – UI Tweaks, Bug Fixes, and Sword Swings
notes.content:
📋 Full Patch Notes
This patch focuses on tightening up some core systems and laying the groundwork for the next major additions. While it's not a massive content drop, it clears out some long-standing annoyances and adds a few new tools for testing what's in place.
[hr][/hr]🖼️ UI Overhaul
The in-game UI has been reorganized for better usability.

The Quit button has been moved into the Settings menu, instead of sitting out in the open. This was both for cleaner design and to avoid accidental rage quits.

Minor polish to various panels to prep for more incoming settings and options.
[hr][/hr]🎮 Controls & Commands Panel
A new “?” button has been added to the main UI.

Clicking it opens a panel with:

A quick reference list of game controls.

A few built-in console-style commands already usable in the game (with more coming).

This will expand over time as new features are added that benefit from testing or command toggling.
[hr][/hr]🎒 Inventory Bug Fixes
Addressed a stacking bug where players could endlessly duplicate items under certain drag/drop conditions.

Refactored parts of the inventory backend to better handle slot state updates after dropping or moving stacks.

Fixed a few edge cases involving splitting stacks and merging back into full ones.
[hr][/hr]🗡️ Sword Animation Added
Fred now has a basic sword swing animation.

There's no combat interaction just yet — this is purely visual for now, to test animation flow and tool switching.

Animation direction is based on movement facing (north, south, east, west).
[hr][/hr]🔜 Coming Next
A damage testing zone: A small test room with dummies or targets to try out attacks once they’re wired up.

A scene selector, accessible from debug or main UI, to let you jump between:

Starting island

Inventory test space

Combat room

Whatever else is ready to preview

First enemy types — nothing too deadly, but something to hit that hits back.
[hr][/hr]
As always, this is a work in progress. Art, balance, and layout are all subject to change. If something feels janky, broken, or just annoying — throw it in the Discord.

👉 Join the Discord

Thanks for testing — and for helping Fred survive his post-honeymoon nightmare.
